findings.impact: The Markdown says all independent structured-review attempts were NOT_RUN because of infrastructure/schema failures, while the adjacent JSON records ROUND_1_NOT_CLEAN and four committed schema-valid Codex reviews contain substantive findings. This makes the adversarial-review status internally inconsistent and incorrectly erases an observed failed review round.
findings.minimal_fix: Update the Markdown and progress receipt to record ROUND_1_NOT_CLEAN and the four committed reviews, reserving NOT_RUN only for the separate failed provider attempts; synchronize the JSON reason accordingly.

findings.impact: The durable GitHub/Discord receipt binds the original 7a9999f report and manifest hashes, but both artifacts were materially corrected afterward and current HEAD hashes differ. Therefore the receipt does not establish delivery of the current reviewed report/manifest identity.
findings.minimal_fix: Post and DM the corrected HEAD artifacts, then append a new immutable receipt containing their commit, byte counts, SHA-256 values, GitHub comment identifier, and Discord message identifier while preserving the historical receipt.
